[SWS_CanSM_00667]
Status:
DRAFT
Upstream requirements: SRS_Can_01142
⌈If the CanIf module notifies PN availability for a configured CAN Controller to the
CanSM module with the callback function CanSM_ConfirmCtrlPnAvailability
(ref. to [SWS_CanSM_91004]), then the CanSM module shall call the API CanNm_
ConfirmPnAvailability (ref. to [SWS_CanSM_91002]) with the related CAN net-
work as channel to confirm the PN availability to the CanNm module.⌋
